newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI HEAT TO PLAY MACCABI TEL AVIV IN ISRAEL.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI HEAT TO PLAY MACCABI TEL AVIV IN ISRAEL.

text.p: The NBA's Miami Heat will play Maccabi Tel Aviv at Yad Eliyahu Arena in Israel on October 12, 1998, the clubs announced Monday.
For the Heat, Eastern Conference finalists this season led by stars Alonzo Mourning and Tim Hardaway and coached by Pat Riley, the preseason game will be their first trip overseas.

Maccabi Tel Aviv, Israeli champions 26 of the past 27 years, are led by Doron Sheffer and Nadav Henefeld, both former University of Connecticut players, former Dallas Mavericks player Randy White and point guard Oded Kattash.
